title: FTyInstRow
html:
定义组：System F 语法。有序参数：z1852、z1853、z1854。

删除一个类型绑定的替换，不是保持长度的自由变量替换。：单行局部条件。

规范公式

(@ FTyInstRow z1852 z1853 z1854) 按 无捕获缩写规则 展开为下列有限公式。参数只取集合，不能填入函数项或元语言公式。

(exists c
  (exists s
    (exists t
      (exists u
        (and
          (exists z1857
            (and (exists z1858 (and (@ Pair t u z1858) (@ Pair s z1858 z1857))) (@ Pair c z1857 z1854)))
          (and
            (@ Nat c)
            (and
              (@ PolyTyAny s)
              (and
                (@ PolyTyAny t)
                (and
                  (@ PolyTyAny u)
                  (or
                    (exists z1859
                      (and
                        (@ FTV z1859 t)
                        (or
                          (and (in z1859 c) (= t u))
                          (or
                            (exists z1861 (and (= z1859 c) (and (@ Num0 z1861) (@ FTyShift z1861 c s u))))
                            (exists z1860 (and (in c z1859) (and (@ Succ z1860 z1859) (@ FTV z1860 u))))))))
                    (or
                      (exists z1862
                        (exists z1863
                          (exists z1864
                            (exists z1865
                            (and
                            (@ TArr z1862 z1863 t)
                            (and
                            (@ TArr z1864 z1865 u)
                            (and
                            (exists z1867
                            (exists z1868
                            (and
                            (in z1867 z1853)
                            (and
                            (@ App z1852 z1867 z1868)
                            (exists z1869
                            (and (exists z1870 (and (@ Pair z1862 z1864 z1870) (@ Pair s z1870 z1869))) (@ Pair c z1869 z1868)))))))
                            (exists z1871
                            (exists z1872
                            (and
                            (in z1871 z1853)
                            (and
                            (@ App z1852 z1871 z1872)
                            (exists z1873
                            (and (exists z1874 (and (@ Pair z1863 z1865 z1874) (@ Pair s z1874 z1873))) (@ Pair c z1873 z1872))))))))))))))
                      (exists z1862
                        (exists z1863
                          (exists z1866
                            (and
                            (@ FForall z1862 t)
                            (and
                            (@ FForall z1863 u)
                            (and
                            (@ Succ c z1866)
                            (exists z1875
                            (exists z1876
                            (and
                            (in z1875 z1853)
                            (and
                            (@ App z1852 z1875 z1876)
                            (exists z1877
                            (and (exists z1878 (and (@ Pair z1862 z1863 z1878) (@ Pair s z1878 z1877))) (@ Pair z1866 z1877 z1876))))))))))))))))))))))))

直接依赖

App；FForall；FTV；FTyShift；Nat；Num0；Pair；PolyTyAny；Succ；TArr
